source: Legend of the Five Rings 4th Edition Core Rulebook, Book of Fire, pp. 205-207 (Miscellaneous Equipment, Horses, Clothing & Accessories, The Traveling Pack)

items.name: Backpack
items.description: Rokugani backpacks are built upon wicker frames, making them fairly rigid.

items.name: Ball, Kemari
items.description: A leather ball used to play kemari, a popular game.

items.name: Baskets
items.description: The most common container, crafted from wicker. Sometimes worn as hats.

items.name: Blacksmith’s Hammer
items.description: Necessary for an armorer or weaponsmith to craft.

items.name: Blanket
items.description: A coarse blanket appropriate for travel, often used stacked for warmth.

items.name: Bottle of Bleach/Dye
items.description: Used primarily for clothes-making and hair coloration.

items.name: Bottle of Sake
items.description: Rice wine, a very popular beverage among bushi.

items.name: Bottle of Shochu
items.description: A very strong, distilled alcoholic beverage.

items.name: Bottle, Empty
items.description: Clay or occasionally imported glass, used for storing liquids for travel.

items.name: Books and Scrolls
items.description: Sturdy records used for journals and recording new information.

items.name: Bowyer’s Kit
items.description: Used for maintenance of bow and arrows.

items.name: Brazier
items.description: Vessel for holding burning substances or for heating liquids.

items.name: Bucket
items.description: A metal vessel with a handle, primarily for toting water.

items.name: Candle
items.description: A simple, hand-dipped candle.

items.name: Chest
items.description: Wooden chest with a lock for storing precious items.

items.name: Chopsticks
items.description: Eating utensils.

items.name: Cloth, Silk Bolt
items.description: Used for mending, protective wrapping, etc.

items.name: Coin Purse
items.description: A small, easily concealed bag.

items.name: Daisho Stand
items.description: Easily disassembled and carried, this is a stand for displaying one’s daisho and tanto.

items.name: Dice and Dice Cup
items.description: Used primarily for gambling.

items.name: Divination Kit
items.description: Sets of coins or carved sticks used for divining.

items.name: Finger of Jade
items.description: Rare, and used to ward off the Shadowlands.
items.price: 1 koku if it can be found at all

items.name: Fishing Kit
items.description: Consists of a hook, strong string, a small net, and a cleaning knife.

items.name: Flint and Steel
items.description: Useful for creating sparks and lighting fires.

items.name: Furoshiki Sack
items.description: A sturdy silken bag with a drawstring.

items.name: Games, Traveling
items.description: Small sets of go, shogi, or other games.

items.name: Grapple Hook
items.description: An iron hook meant to be attached to a rope for climbing.

items.name: Kiseru
items.description: A simple smoking pipe.

items.name: Kubi Bukuro
items.description: A net bag for holding and displaying the severed head of an enemy.

items.name: Lanterns
items.description: Used for decoration and illumination.

items.name: Lantern Oil
items.description: A flask with two hours of oil.

items.name: Lucky Cricket
items.description: A small cricket in a cage.

items.name: Medicine Kit
items.description: Needle and thread, cloth bandages, herbal disinfectants (10 uses).

items.name: Mirrors
items.description: Glass or metal, polished to a high sheen.

items.name: Mortar & Pestle
items.description: Used to grind and mix ingredients.

items.name: Musical Instruments
items.description: Common samples include the samisen, biwa, flute, and drum.

items.name: Palanquin
items.description: Elaborate personal carriage, carried by servants.

items.name: Paper
items.description: Ideal for writing for scrolls or “books.”

items.name: Parchment & Charcoal
items.description: Cheaper alternative to brush and ink.

items.name: Personal Seal or Chop
items.description: Used to sign formal documents and verify identities.

items.name: Pet
items.description: Dog, cat, songbird, monkey, or others. Incapable of combat.

items.name: Pillow Book
items.description: Small, loosely bound book about romance, adventure, or poetry.

items.name: Pot, Iron
items.description: Used for cooking while traveling.

items.name: Quiver
items.description: Cloth satchel for arrows (holds up to 60).

items.name: Rope
items.description: Varying quality made of hemp, hair, or silk.
items.price: 5 zeni per foot of reasonable quality rope

items.name: Sake Cup
items.description: Guests often bring their own cup to events.

items.name: Shovel
items.description: A simple digging tool.

items.name: Small Back Banner
items.description: Identify name, rank, family, and Clan.

items.name: Small Folding Stool
items.description: Carried by soldiers to conserve strength.

items.name: Small Knife
items.description: Used for carving or personal grooming.

items.name: Small Painting or Sculpture
items.description: Carried for sentiment or gifts.

items.name: Small Statue of Fortune/Ancestor
items.description: Carried for sentimental reasons or luck.

items.name: Spices
items.description: Used to add flavor to food while traveling, or for barter.

items.name: Sweets
items.description: Popular snacks include small cakes, candies, buns, or honeyed rice.

items.name: Tatami Mat
items.description: Used for sitting or sleeping on the ground or floor.

items.name: Tattoo Needles
items.description: Made of steel or bamboo.

items.name: Tea Set
items.description: Necessary to perform the sacred tea ceremony.

items.name: Tent, Chomchog
items.description: A large and elaborate tent favored by the Unicorn.

items.name: Tent, Small
items.description: Suitable for two people.

items.name: Tent, Yurt
items.description: Smaller than the chomchog but still larger than average, favored by the Unicorn.

items.name: Traveling Rations
items.description: Dried rice or fish, wrapped in paper.

items.name: Umbrella
items.description: Made of wicker and silk to hold off the elements.

items.name: Walking Stick
items.description: A simple cane to aid in walking. Not suitable for a weapon.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description: Used to sharpen weapons, but not the katana or wakizashi.

items.name: Writing Box
items.description: The sumi-e box, contains brushes, ink stones, a water bowl, and sand.

items.name: Cap, Courtier’s
items.description: Peaked cap popular among courtiers and bureaucrats.

items.name: Fan, Courtier’s
items.description: Paper fan with customized patterns.

items.name: Hakama
items.description: Knee-length trousers.

items.name: Haori
items.description: Jacket-like garment worn over a kimono.

items.name: Kataginu
items.description: Vest-like garment worn over kimono to emphasize shoulders.

items.name: Kimono
items.description: The basic robe worn by all samurai. Comes with belt/sash (obi).

items.name: Makeup Kit
items.description: Face powders and paints.

items.name: Mask
items.description: Vary from silk to metal (mempo). Often intricately patterned.

items.name: Netsuke
items.description: Jewelry such as earring, ring, bracelet, etc.

items.name: Obi Pouch
items.description: A small pouch that fastens to the belt.

items.name: Perfume
items.description: Made from various herbs and common substances.

items.name: Sandals
items.description: The simplest and most common form of footwear.

items.name: Snow Shoes
items.description: Wide-framed shoes to prevent sinking in the snow.

items.name: Traveling Cloak
items.description: Thick coat worn over clothes while traveling.

items.name: Wide-brimmed Straw Hat
items.description: Used for protecting the face from the sun.

items.name: War Paint, Vial
items.description: Popular among Crab, Unicorn, and Lion warriors.

items.name: Wig
items.description: Used for disguise or to gain attention in court.

items.name: Rokugani Pony
items.description: All horses require roughly a koku of upkeep per month in terms of feeding, stabling, etc. Rules and abilities for horses are provided in the Book of Void.

items.name: Gaijin Riding Horse
items.description: All horses require roughly a koku of upkeep per month in terms of feeding, stabling, etc. Rules and abilities for horses are provided in the Book of Void.

items.name: Utaku War Horse
items.description: This is a minimum, and possession of one of these horses by an outsider is usually considered an affront to the honor of the Unicorn Clan, most likely resulting in duels. All horses require roughly a koku of upkeep per month.

items.name: Traveling Pack
items.description: A traveling bag, often called a furoshiki, filled with various items the individual might be interested in. When creating a character, select any ten of the listed items that are found within the Traveling Pack.

travelingPack.source: Legend of the Five Rings 4th Edition Core Rulebook, Book of Fire, p. 207
